Subject: ACME Health: evaluation acceptance & approval milestones

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our discussion, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft to help ACME get from POC acceptance to procurement approval for the GCP private offer. High-level goals:

- 2-week extended eval (technical + performance checks)
- Procurement review of billing path and PO templates
- Final approvals and contract signature (DocuSign)

I attached a first-pass spreadsheet with milestones and owners (ACME / Redwood). Can you loop in the procurement approver who will own the PO and billing questions? If you prefer AWS or Azure instead of GCP, flag that — we can model both billing routes.

Proposed next steps:
1) ACME confirms preferred cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure) by 4/14
2) Redwood provides final MAP + PO template and procurement questionnaire by 4/15
3) Procurement approval meeting week of 4/18

Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft, milestones)

Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the milestones.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

- Approval window: our finance committee meets on 4/20; we need signed commercial terms by EOD 4/19 to make that meeting.

Jordan / Priya —

Appreciate the clarity. Ben (Sales) and Rishi (Finance) are on the thread — adding Monica (Legal) for contract / PO language.

A few clarifications and commitments from our side:

- We will return the completed procurement questionnaire by EOD 4/15.
- Attached is our MAP with milestone owners filled and two billing paths explained: (A) GCP private offer via Marketplace (recommended for procurement ease) and (B) Direct commitment with monthly invoices.

From: procurement@acmehealth.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Narang <priya.narang@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Health: evaluation acceptance & approval milestones

Laura / Ben —

We reviewed the MAP and the billing options. A couple of procurement redlines and questions before legal signs off:

1) Marketplace private offer: we need a clear statement of who is the billed party (ACME Health) and whether Redwood or the cloud vendor issues the invoice. Also need expected invoice frequency and a sample invoice.
2) PO template: we prefer PO -> Redwood (direct invoiced) with a goodwill clause to indicate fallbacks if marketplace acceptance is delayed.
3) SLAs and data residency: please confirm the private offer will run in GCP region us-central1 and include an audit log export frequency.

We have a brief redline we can attach — but can you first confirm answers to the above so our legal team can expedite?

Procurement is also open to a short 30-minute approval call tomorrow 4/16 at 10am PT to resolve open items.

Procurement Team
ACME Health
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: procurement@acmehealth.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Health: evaluation acceptance & approval milestones

Hi Priya / ACME procurement —

Short answers up front:
- Billed party: ACME Health. For the Marketplace private offer, the cloud vendor issues the invoice to ACME. Redwood will furnish a reconciliation statement monthly and can provide sample invoice fields.
- Invoice frequency: monthly by default; quarterly with prepayment is possible if ACME prefers.
- PO flow: if ACME chooses direct PO -> Redwood, we will accept a standard PO and issue monthly invoices to ACME. We will include a fallback clause in the SOW to cover delays in private offer acceptance by the cloud provider.
- Region and audit logs: confirmed us-central1. Audit log export cadence: configurable; default daily export to customer-controlled GCS bucket.

I've attached our PO_Template.pdf and a brief sample invoice stub for your finance review. If the 10am PT slot tomorrow works, Monica and I will join to close the remaining redlines.

Attachment: PO_Template.pdf

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
